packageRules.description: sevenz-rust2 still asks for lzma-rust2 0.23, so taking 0.24 here would build the LZMA codec into the binary twice. Lift this when sevenz-rust2 follows.

reqwest 0.13 renamed the TLS features: rustls-tls-native-roots is gone, and 0.13's rustls feature brings aws-lc-rs, the backend this workspace refuses for its OpenSSL licence and its C toolchain. The port is rustls-no-provider plus installing the ring provider before the first request, in both fcmd-s3 and fcmd-net — a commit of its own rather than a version bump. See docs/BACKLOG.md.
